Only triggered if the above didn't return with text_contents\n            raise ToolError(f\"MCP tool error: {result}\")\n```\n\nIf we don't return the errors that may be thrown from the MCP server into `result.content.text`, the model will not get to learn from the output of the MCP server and thus get stuck in a failure loop.",

│        • Logs all except CHAT_SAVE to a file named "logging.log",  │
│          using the same format as console                          │
│        • Logs only CHAT_SAVE level messages to a separate file     │

│     • The _level_format function formats logs differently          │
│       depending on level:                                          │
